articles.title: Mysterious UFO Spotted Near International Space Station In NASA Video Sparks Claims Of Near Collision
articles.summary: A prolific UFO researcher claims he spotted an object flying close to the International Space Station in a recent NASA ...
articles.body:
A prolific UFO researcher claims he spotted an object flying close to the International Space Station in a recent NASA video. He also claims that the UFO was large enough to have damaged the International Space Station if it had collided with it.
The mysterious, disc-shapedUFOappeared in footage of aSpaceXDragon cargo ship approaching the International Space Station in October, theDaily Mailreports.
UFO Researcher Claims Object Came Within 82 Feet Of Space Station
Scott Waring, who runs the websiteUFO Sightings Daily,estimates the UFO was 23 feet across and passed within 82 feet of theInternational Space Station’spanels. He also said he was surprised that no one involved in the mission seemed to acknowledge the object.
“The crew on board the DragonX said nothing about it, notNASAcontrol, not even the station itself,” he said.
Waring believes the footage also shows anotherUFOmoving erratically around the Dragon spacecraft.
“Do you see how they’re moving very oddly?” he asked in a YouTube video describing the sighting. “Moving like no aircraft we’ve ever seen or spacecraft. It doesn’t conform to physics the way humans expect things to. The way it moves is bizarre.”
NASA, however, only reported a routine docking involving more than 6,300 pounds of supplies and scientific equipment. There was no mention of a UFO or any near collision.
Mysterious UFO Sightings Continue To Make Headlines
This UFO sighting around the International Space Station wasn’t the only unusual encounter to make headlines recently.
An airline passenger reportedly filmed atriangular UFO over Utah, while another triangular object wasrecorded near a volcano in Mexico. Both sightings aresimilar to others. Many people believe volcanoes are the homes ofsecret alien bases.
Several strange aircraft encounters with UFOs have also been reported recently.
Just this week, a British Airways jet carrying 256 passengers reportedlycame within 50 feet of a mysterious objectover England. Pilots flying over Ohio also recentlyphotographed a strange, pill-shaped UFOthey couldn’t identify.
As for the latest NASA footage, Waring admits he can’t prove the objects are alien spacecraft. That said, he still believes he captured something extraordinary on video.
“Maybe I’m wrong. Maybe this isn’t a UFO,” he said. “But for me, this just confirms that intelligent life is out there.”
articles.title_cn: NASA视频中国际空间站附近出现神秘UFO，引发近乎碰撞的说法
articles.summary_cn: 一位多产的UFO研究者声称，他在NASA最近的一段视频中发现一个物体飞近国际空间站。
articles.body_cn:
一位多产的UFO研究者声称，他在NASA最近的一段视频中发现一个物体飞近国际空间站。他还称，这个UFO体积足够大，如果与空间站相撞，足以对其造成损坏。
据《每日邮报》报道，这个神秘的碟形UFO出现在10月SpaceX龙飞船货运飞船接近国际空间站的画面中。
运营网站“UFO每日目击”的斯科特·沃林（Scott Waring）估计，这个UFO直径约23英尺，从国际空间站太阳能板附近约82英尺处飞过。他还表示，令他惊讶的是，参与此次任务的人员似乎都没有注意到这个物体。
“龙飞船上的人员对此只字未提，NASA控制中心没有提，甚至连空间站本身也没有提，”他说。
沃林认为，这段画面还显示另一个UFO在龙飞船周围不规则地移动。
“你看到它们的移动方式有多奇怪了吗？”他在一段描述此次目击的YouTube视频中问道。“它们的移动方式与我们见过的任何飞机或航天器都不同。它不符合人类所预期的物理规律。它的运动方式非常怪异。”
然而，NASA仅报告了一次例行对接，涉及超过6300磅的补给和科学设备。没有任何关于UFO或近乎碰撞的提及。
围绕国际空间站的这次UFO目击并非近期唯一登上头条的不寻常遭遇。
据报道，一名航空公司乘客在犹他州上空拍摄到一个三角形UFO，另有一个三角形物体在墨西哥一座火山附近被记录下来。这两次目击与其他一些目击事件相似。许多人相信火山是秘密外星基地的所在地。
近期还报告了数起飞机与UFO的奇怪遭遇。

articles.title: Department of War Issues New UAP Disclosure Waiver; But Similar Protections Already Existed
articles.summary: The Department of War announced September 14, 2026, that it has issued a targeted legal waiver allowing current and former military personnel, civilian employees and contractors to provide protected information concerning Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena (UAP) directly to designated representatives of the government’s PURSUE effort. articles.body:
The Department of War announced September 14, 2026, that it has issued a targeted legal waiver allowing current and former military personnel, civilian employees and contractors to provide protected information concerning Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena (UAP) directly to designated representatives of the government’s PURSUE effort.
According to the Department, the waiver establishes an “authorized, legally protected disclosure mechanism” for individuals possessing UAP-related National Defense Information, or NDI.
“This waiver establishes an authorized, legally protected disclosure mechanism for current and former personnel to provide UAP-related National Defense Information (NDI) to designated representatives of the PURSUE effort,” the Department said.
The announcement is significant, particularly because the Department expressly references Special Access Program Indoctrination Agreements alongside conventional nondisclosure agreements.
But the underlying concept, allowing government personnel to provide otherwise protected UAP information to specifically authorized government investigators without violating their NDAs, is not new.
Documentspreviously obtainedand published by The Black Vault show that similar protections were already established for disclosures to the All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office (AARO). Those protections became a central issue during AARO’sunsuccessful attemptsto interview former intelligence official David Grusch in 2023.
The new announcement therefore raises an important question: What does the PURSUE waiver provide that the government did not already provide through AARO?
The public announcement does not fully answer that question.
According to the Department of War, the new directive covers “all current and former DOW service members, civilian personnel, and contractors holding or previously granted access to UAP-related National Defense Information.”
Those individuals are now authorized to provide that information directly to official PURSUE representatives.
The Department specifically states:
“The waiver supersedes civil and administrative enforcement provisions contained within Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs) and Special Access Program Indoctrination Agreements (SAPIAs) previously executed within the United States, strictly for communications directed to the PURSUE team.”
That final limitation is important.
The announcement does not provide blanket authorization for personnel to disclose protected information publicly. It does not state that classified information may be provided to journalists or released independently by the individual possessing it. Nor does the announcement itself declassify information.
The authorization described by the Department applies specifically to disclosures made to PURSUE.
According to the Department, information entering that channel would undergo “systematic review, security evaluation, and potential declassification.”

articles.title_cn: 战争部发布新的UAP披露豁免令，但类似保护措施早已存在
articles.summary_cn: 战争部于2026年9月14日宣布，已发布一项有针对性的法律豁免令，允许现任和前任军事人员、文职雇员及承包商就涉及不明异常现象（UAP）的受保护信息，直接向政府PURSUE项目的指定代表提供。
articles.body_cn:
战争部于2026年9月14日宣布，已发布一项有针对性的法律豁免令，允许现任和前任军事人员、文职雇员及承包商就涉及不明异常现象（UAP）的受保护信息，直接向政府PURSUE项目的指定代表提供。
据该部门称，这项豁免令为掌握UAP相关国防信息（NDI）的个人建立了一个“经授权、受法律保护的披露机制”。
“这项豁免令为现任和前任人员建立了一个经授权、受法律保护的披露机制，使其能够向PURSUE项目的指定代表提供UAP相关国防信息（NDI），”该部门表示。
这一宣布意义重大，尤其是因为该部门在常规保密协议之外，还明确提到了特别访问项目知悉协议。
但其基本概念——允许政府人员在不违反保密协议的前提下，向特定授权的政府调查人员提供原本受保护的UAP信息——并不新鲜。
《黑库》（The Black Vault）此前获取并公布的文件显示，针对向全域异常解决办公室（AARO）披露信息的类似保护措施早已建立。这些保护措施在2023年AARO试图约谈前情报官员大卫·格鲁施（David Grusch）未果的过程中成为核心问题。
因此，这一新宣布提出了一个重要问题：PURSUE豁免令提供了哪些政府此前通过AARO未曾提供的保护？
公开声明并未完全回答这一问题。
据战争部称，新指令涵盖“所有现任和前任战争部军人、文职人员及承包商，凡持有或此前曾获准接触UAP相关国防信息者”。
这些个人现已被授权直接向官方……提供该信息。

articles.title: Navy Releases Massive Cache of Scott Bray UAP Emails After Four Years; More Than 300 Pages Withheld in Full
articles.summary: The Department of the Navy has released more than 1,300 pages of emails and related records involving former Deputy Director of Naval Intelligence Scott W. Bray, opening a broad window into government communications surrounding unidentified aerial phenomena during a pivotal period in the Pentagon’s modern UAP effort. The records were obtained by The Black Vault [...] The post Navy Releases Massive
articles.body:
The Department of the Navy has released more than 1,300 pages of emails and related records involving former Deputy Director of Naval Intelligence Scott W. Bray, opening a broad window into government communications surrounding unidentified aerial phenomena during a pivotal period in the Pentagon’s modern UAP effort.
The records were obtained by The Black Vault through a Freedom of Information Act request filed on May 24, 2022. The request sought emails sent to, from, copied to or blind-copied to Bray containing terms including “Unidentified Aerial Phenomena,” “UAP,” “UAPTF,” “UFO,” “AATIP,” “AAWSAP” and several related phrases.
More than four years later, the Navy responded on September 23, 2026. According to its response, the search located 1,321 pages of responsive records. The Navy withheld 302 pages in their entirety, while releasing the remaining 1,019 pages with redactions under several FOIA exemptions.
Bray served as Deputy Director of Naval Intelligence and Director of the Naval Intelligence Activity during much of the period covered by the records. His position placed him within a network of Navy, Defense Department and Intelligence Community officials dealing with UAP reporting, briefings, congressional interest and the development of what ultimately became the Navy-led Unidentified Aerial Phenomena Task Force.
One email in the release described the relationship directly, stating that John “Jay” Stratton “leads the UAP Task Force effort for Navy… working directly for Scott Bray, our Deputy Director of Naval Intelligence.”
Bray later became one of the government’s most visible officials on the UAP issue. On May 17, 2022, he appeared with Under Secretary of Defense for Intelligence and Security Ronald Moultrie before a House Intelligence subcommittee during a public congressional hearing devoted to UAP. The hearing was followed by a classified session.
The newly released records provide a much larger documentary backdrop to that public role.
A Broad Look Behind the Government’s UAP Effort
The correspondence stretches across years and includes exchanges involving Stratton, Defense Intelligence official Neill Tipton, senior Navy officials, admirals, Pentagon public-affairs personnel and other Defense and Intelligence Community officials.
For example, a March 2020 exchange shows Tipton, who was then identified in his signature block as Director of Defense Intelligence, Collection and Special Programs in OUSD(I&S), telling Bray that he had a document “relevant to our discussion the other day” that he preferred to deliver in hard copy. Other correspondence concerning a planned Senate Select Committee on Intelligence briefing includes Bray, Stratton, Tipton and Rear Adm. Kelly Aeschbach.
Elsewhere, the records show Stratton discussing proposed public language concerning the UAP effort and whether it should be reviewed by Bray before being sent forward. Other email traffic includes Vice Adm. Matthew Kohler, Rear Adm. Charles Brown and Rear Adm.
articles.title_cn: 海军四年后公布斯科特·布雷大量UAP邮件，逾300页被全文扣留
articles.summary_cn: 海军部公布了超过1300页涉及前海军情报局副局长斯科特·W·布雷（Scott W. Bray）的邮件及相关记录，为了解五角大楼现代UAP工作关键时期的政府通信打开了一扇广阔的窗口。
articles.body_cn:
海军部公布了超过1300页涉及前海军情报局副局长斯科特·W·布雷（Scott W. Bray）的邮件及相关记录，为了解五角大楼现代UAP工作关键时期的政府通信打开了一扇广阔的窗口。
这些记录由《黑库》（The Black Vault）通过2022年5月24日提交的《信息自由法》请求获得。该请求寻求获取发送给布雷、由布雷发送、抄送或密送布雷的邮件，其中包含“不明空中现象”“UAP”“UAPTF”“UFO”“AATIP”“AAWSAP”等关键词及相关短语。
四年多后，海军于2026年9月23日作出回应。根据其回复，检索共找到1321页相关记录。海军将302页全文扣留，其余1019页在依据多项《信息自由法》豁免条款进行删减后予以公布。
在记录所涵盖的大部分时期内，布雷担任海军情报局副局长兼海军情报活动主任。他的职位使他处于一个由海军、国防部和情报界官员组成的网络之中，负责处理UAP报告、简报、国会关注以及最终发展为海军主导的不明空中现象工作组的相关工作。
公布的一封邮件直接描述了这一关系，称约翰·“杰伊”·斯特拉顿（John “Jay” Stratton）“领导海军UAP工作组的工作……直接向我们的海军情报局副局长斯科特·布雷汇报”。
布雷后来成为政府在UAP问题上最引人注目的官员之一。2022年5月17日，他与国防部情报与安全副部长罗纳德·莫尔特里（Ronald Moultrie）一起出席众议院情报小组委员会的一场公开国会听证会，该听证会专门讨论UAP问题。听证会后还举行了机密会议。
新公布的记录为这一公开角色提供了更为宏大的文献背景。

articles.title: What is the Electronic Reading Room?
articles.summary: Welcome to the Central Intelligence Agency's Freedom of Information Act Electronic Reading Room.
articles.summary_cn: 欢迎来到中央情报局《信息自由法》电子阅览室。
articles.body_cn:
中央情报局（CIA）的《信息自由法》电子阅览室是该机构面向公众开放的重要信息窗口。根据《信息自由法》（FOIA）的规定，公众有权申请获取联邦政府机构持有的记录，而电子阅览室则是CIA主动公开部分高频请求文件和历史解密档案的在线平台。

该阅览室收录的内容涵盖广泛，包括已解密的历史情报文件、UAP/UFO相关记录、以及公众反复申请查阅的热门文档。用户可以通过关键词检索、按收藏分类浏览等方式查找资料。对于UFO/UAP研究者和爱好者而言，这一平台是获取官方解密文件的重要渠道之一，许多涉及不明空中现象的历史档案正是通过此类电子阅览室向公众披露的。

需要注意的是，电子阅览室中公开的文件通常经过审查和删减处理，部分敏感信息会依据法定豁免条款被遮蔽。公众若未能在阅览室中找到所需资料，仍可另行提交《信息自由法》申请。

articles.title_cn: 英国航空飞行员报告UFO危险接近飞往纽约的客机，官方调查反而引发更多疑问
articles.summary_cn: 英国航空飞行员报告，一个UFO危险地接近了一架飞往纽约的航班。
articles.body_cn:
一名英国航空公司飞行员报告称，在执行飞往纽约的航班任务时，一个不明飞行物（UFO）以危险的距离接近了客机，事件随后引发官方调查，但调查结果反而带来了更多疑问。

据报告，这架英国航空客机当时正飞越大西洋前往纽约，机上载有数百名乘客。飞行员在飞行过程中目击到一个无法立即识别的物体出现在飞机附近，距离之近足以引发航空安全方面的担忧。飞行员随即向空中交通管制部门报告了这一情况。

官方随后对此事展开调查，但调查的结论并未平息外界疑虑。目前尚不清楚该物体究竟是什么——是无人机、气象气球、还是其他类型的飞行器，官方均未给出明确答案。调查中暴露出的信息空白和矛盾之处，反而让UFO研究者和航空安全专家提出了更多问题。

此类民航飞行员目击UAP的事件近年来屡有报告，美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）和相关部门已逐步建立起飞行员报告不明空中现象的正式渠道，但多数案例最终仍以“无法识别”告终。

articles.title: Pilots Photograph Mysterious Pill-Shaped UFO While Flying 41,000 Feet Over Ohio
articles.summary: Two pilots flying a private jet over Ohio spotted something very unusual outside their aircraft, and even after an investigation, nobody ...
articles.body:
Two pilots flying a private jet over Ohio spotted something very unusual outside their aircraft, and even after an investigation, nobody seems to know exactly what it was.
The object, described as a metallic, pill-shapedUFOapproximately 30 feet tall, reportedly appeared near the plane as the pilots approached a thunderstorm. Even stranger, neither air traffic control nor the aircraft’s collision avoidance system detected anything in the area.
The encounter occurred on August 16 near Tiffin,Ohio, but details weren’t made public until October 26, when the National UFO Reporting Center (NUFORC) released its investigation.
Pilots Describe Encounter With Mysterious UFO Over Ohio
According toNUFORC, the pilots were flying at about 41,000 feet when they spotted a strange, cigar- or pill-shaped object that appeared to emerge from storm clouds ahead of them.
TheUFOappeared to be traveling toward the aircraft before passing on the left, coming within an estimated two to three miles of the plane. The encounter lasted about two minutes, during which the aircraft was traveling at around 380 mph. One pilot photographed theUFOwith his iPhone after it passed their plane.
One of the pilots, identified only as “J,” described it as silver, highly reflective, and pill-shaped, standing vertically. He also reported seeing no wings, seams, or other visible flight controls.
Initially, the pilot suspected it might be a weather balloon. However, he questioned that explanation because of its unusual shape and the severe weather conditions. The thunderstorm clouds reportedly reached as high as 55,000 feet, and the pilots later experienced engine icing and moderate turbulence while flying through them.
Investigators Still Haven’t Identified The Mysterious Object
The pilots contacted Cleveland Center air traffic controllers to ask whether any aircraft or weather balloons were nearby. They were told that nothing matching their description appeared on radar.
In fact, according toNUFORC, the air traffic controller jokingly told them to report the incident and “make sure you include what color thealienwas.”
NUFORC investigator Ben Hansen subsequently obtained FAA radar information and air traffic control communications. He couldn’t find a corresponding balloon launch, although they haven’t completely ruled out that possibility.
“Coupled with the witness’s estimate that the object was at least 30 feet in height and uniformly shaped without tapering at the top or bottom, it presents some challenges to the balloon theory,” he wrote.
The sighting is similar to two other incidents. One involved a Southwest Airlines passenger who filmed a mysteriousTic Tac-shaped UFOflying over California. In that case, the passenger also reported that the object had “no visible means of propulsion.” A few months later, a man in Clovis, California, filmed what he believes wasanother “Tic Tac” UFO sightingover the Golden State.

articles.title_cn: 飞行员在俄亥俄州上空41000英尺处拍摄到神秘药丸状UFO
articles.summary_cn: 两名飞行员驾驶私人飞机飞越俄亥俄州时，在机外发现了非常不寻常的东西，即便经过调查，似乎也没有人知道那究竟是什么。
articles.body_cn:
两名飞行员驾驶私人飞机飞越俄亥俄州时，在机外发现了非常不寻常的东西，即便经过调查，似乎也没有人知道那究竟是什么。
据描述，这个金属质感的药丸状UFO高约30英尺，在飞行员接近雷暴时出现在飞机附近。更奇怪的是，空中交通管制和飞机的防撞系统均未在该区域探测到任何物体。
此次遭遇发生在8月16日，地点位于俄亥俄州蒂芬（Tiffin）附近，但细节直到10月26日美国国家UFO报告中心（NUFORC）发布调查报告后才公之于众。
据NUFORC称，飞行员当时在约41000英尺高度飞行，发现一个奇怪的雪茄状或药丸状物体似乎从他们前方的雷暴云中冒出。
这个UFO似乎朝飞机方向移动，随后从左侧掠过，与飞机最近距离估计为两到三英里。整个遭遇持续约两分钟，期间飞机以约每小时380英里的速度飞行。一名飞行员在UFO掠过飞机后用iPhone拍摄了照片。
其中一名仅以“J”标识的飞行员描述该物体为银色、高度反光、呈药丸状，垂直竖立。他还报告称未看到机翼、接缝或其他可见的飞行控制装置。
起初，这名飞行员怀疑它可能是气象气球。然而，由于物体形状异常且天气条件恶劣，他对这一解释存疑。据报道，雷暴云高度达到55000英尺，飞行员随后在穿越云层时遭遇了发动机结冰和中等强度颠簸。
飞行员联系了克利夫兰中心空中交通管制员，询问附近是否有任何飞机或气象气球。他们被告知，雷达上未出现任何符合其描述的物体。
